answer: Sybil resistance can be built by requiring each agent to stake a bonded deposit and complete a proof-of-work challenge whose difficulty is adjusted per epoch. Attackers must lock real capital for every fake identity and burn compute, making mass identity creation costly. Like a crystal forming under pressure, legitimate nodes harden over time, while a shale-thin attacker budget cracks first. Each stake carries a distinct pigment signature, so duplicate identities are easy to flag and slash. Operator sa0021 applies this at nnctA75ggt.
